sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: safe vehicle operation part two (work zones, railroad crossings, sharing the road, parking and reversing, pedestrians, seat belts, child restraints and equipment)
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The Move Over page lists authorized emergency vehicles by statute; only the light colors, the lane-change or slow-down duty and the infraction classes are taught [A05].
The seat belt exemption page is a long list of examples; only the medical documentation rule is taught, and the rest are not turned into exam claims [A10].
The warning-device page mixes car and commercial-vehicle rules; C keeps car rules and C2 marks truck rules as a separate group [A11].
The child back-seat advice is the National Safety Council's recommendation as quoted by the manual, while the under-eight restraint rule is law; the two are kept apart [A10].

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.
